item.coloph: dam pa'i chos pad ma kar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs shind tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo ste /_byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams pa /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su bzung pa /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spa ba /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsang ba'i gnas /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi snying po dang /_sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba /_/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gcig tu 'dus pa /thabs mkhas pa chen po theg pa gcig tu bstan pa don dam pa grub pa bstand pa rdzogs so /_/rgya gar gi 'khan po su ren tra pod de dang /_zhu chen gi lo tsha ba ban d+he ye shes sdes zhus te rtan la phab //_//tshe 'di phyi gnyis /_dam pa'i chos pad ma kar po dang 'byal par shog //_kra shis par cig //_rdzogs s+h+yo //
